children: Enova completed a $500.0 million asset-backed securitization through its subsidiary OnDeck Asset Securitization IV, issuing fixed-rate notes across four classes with a weighted average coupon of 6.22%. Proceeds were used to purchase a revolving pool of small business loans from OnDeck that serve as collateral, with an initial portfolio of about $526 million. The facility features a revolving period through September 2028 and final maturity in October 2032, providing funding to support OnDeck’s small business lending.
: Asset-backed securitization facility and Series 2026-1 Indenture
: Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas, as Indenture Trustee, and institutional investors
: Revolving to Sep 2028; Final maturity Oct 2032
: Fund and refinance small business loan collateral
